quote: Upon approaching an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency which is moving or preparing to move in any direction, including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident, and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of any other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: If the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency: (1) Approaches the driver’s vehicle, proceed as required pursuant to subsection 1 [NRS-484B-267-1a, NRS-484B-267-1b, NRS-484B-267-1c]; or (2) Stops, proceed as required pursuant to NRS 484B.607 [NRS-484B-607-1a, NRS-484B-607-1b, NRS-484B-607-1c, NRS-484B-607-1d]. As used in this section, “preparing to move” means any indication that is visible to an approaching driver that an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle; or (b) The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle.

activation.condition: A qualifying emergency or regulatory vehicle is moving or visibly preparing to move with qualifying flashing lights.

obligation.description: On approach to the driver, follow subsection 1; on stopping, follow NRS 484B.607.

exceptions.source_clause: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
exceptions.description: Original officer direction may change the response.

timing.description: Track vehicle state across approach; do not assign a numeric legal switching threshold.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency
judgment_calls_needed.note: Authorization and role need an original source; blueprint identity alone is insufficient.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: moving or preparing to move in any direction
judgment_calls_needed.note: Join original motion and visibly indicated preparation; no speed cutoff defines preparation.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original equipment and pixels require independent review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
judgment_calls_needed.note: Officer identity, direction content, recipient and time require original review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Approaches the driver’s vehicle, proceed as required pursuant to subsection 1
judgment_calls_needed.note: The three supplied subsection 1 duties require original yield, right-edge position and stop-until-passed review; synthetic response paths are diagnostics.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Stops, proceed as required pursuant to NRS 484B.607
judgment_calls_needed.note: Record the stopped alternative; the exact 484B.607 duties are absent from the frozen corpus.
